text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 500 people rioted in the town of Kasempa on Saturday in protest at the killing of a woman.
- Eight people have died of cholera in the town of Monze.
- Mufulira company Kafironda Explosives will lay off 100 workers next month due to the closure of an outdated nitroglycerine plant.
- Deputy Agriculture Minister Ackson Sejane rebuked farmers who complained about fertiliser price increases, saying they should diversify if they found maize farming too expensive.
